collection-display.purpose: The compact, oversized title on the cabinet index.

recipe-display.purpose: Cocktail names on recipe detail pages.

body.purpose: Facts, ingredient names, and general reading text.

label.purpose: Uppercase cabinet, specimen, and recipe metadata.

reading-quantity.purpose: Serif ingredient measures with tabular numerals.

motion.name: specimen-shift
motion.purpose: Raises and scales a mark, and slides the accent wash through a bay on hover or focus.

motion.name: wash-opacity
motion.purpose: Fades the cabinet bay accent wash.

motion.name: route-specimen
motion.purpose: Carries the named cocktail mark between collection and detail routes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Near-instant fallback for CSS transitions when reduced motion is requested; route view transitions are disabled.

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: A compact ruled masthead that keeps the collection identity and current recipe register visible.
components.css: .ds-masthead { align-items:center; background:#f2f0eb; border-bottom:1px solid #c9c5bb; color:#171714; display:flex; font:400 .75rem/1.45 'Manrope Variable',sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; justify-content:space-between; letter-spacing:.06em; min-height:4.5rem; padding-inline:clamp(1rem,3vw,3rem); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-masthead a { color:inherit; font-weight:720; text-decoration:none; } .ds-masthead span { color:#615f58; } .ds-masthead a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:1px; text-underline-offset:.25em; } .ds-masthead a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #171714; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Cabinet Bay
components.description: A full-cell recipe link with a numbered register, large specimen mark, caption, and accent-wash interaction.
components.html:
01 · OLD FASHIONED
◇

Negroni
components.css: .ds-cabinet-bay { border: 1px solid #171714; background: #f2f0eb; color: #171714; } .ds-cabinet-bay a { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; min-height: 29rem; padding: 1rem; position: relative; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cabinet-bay a::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--accent); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(101%); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 300ms ease-out; } .ds-cabinet-bay a:hover::before, .ds-cabinet-bay a:focus-visible::before { opacity: .09; transform: translateY(0); } .ds-cabinet-bay a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #171714; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-mark, .ds-cabinet-bay h3, .ds-cabinet-bay small { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-mark { align-self: center; justify-self: center; color: var(--accent); font-size: 8rem; transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cabinet-bay a:hover .ds-mark, .ds-cabinet-bay a:focus-visible .ds-mark { transform: translateY(-.5rem) scale(1.035); }

components.name: Cocktail Mark
components.description: A transparent 240-by-240 specimen that layers a cocktail-specific drink drawing over reusable glassware geometry; both inherit the recipe's raw YAML accent.
components.css: .ds-cocktail-mark { color:var(--accent); display:grid; position:relative; width:100%; place-items:center; } .ds-cocktail-mark__drink, .ds-cocktail-mark__glass { display:grid; grid-area:1 / 1; width:100%; place-items:center; } .ds-cocktail-mark svg { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; overflow:visible; }

components.name: Specimen Stage
components.description: The large detail-stage field that frames a mark with an accent tint, registration border, axis, and measurement ticks.
components.html:
EQUAL PARTSCOUPE
◇
components.css: .ds-specimen-stage { align-content: center; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, #f7f6f2); border-right: 1px solid #171714; display: grid; min-height: calc(100vh - 4.5rem); overflow: hidden; padding: clamp(1rem,3vw,3rem); position: relative; } .ds-specimen-stage::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: clamp(1rem,3vw,3rem); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 52%, #c9c5bb); } .ds-specimen-stage::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: var(--accent); opacity: .34; } .ds-register { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; position: absolute; inset: clamp(2rem,5vw,5rem) clamp(2rem,5vw,5rem) auto; z-index: 2; font: 400 .7rem/1.45 'Manrope Variable',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stage-mark { justify-self: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; color: var(--accent); font-size: 12rem; }

components.name: Ingredient Row
components.description: A ruled name-and-measure row whose quantity uses the restrained serif reading voice and an accessible accent/ink mix.
components.css: .ds-ingredient-row { align-items: baseline; border-top: 1px solid #c9c5bb; display: grid; gap: 1rem; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; padding: 1rem 0; color: #171714; font-family: 'Manrope Variable',sans-serif; } .ds-ingredient-row strong { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, #171714); font: 560 1.1rem/1.45 'Source Serif 4 Variable',serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Cocktail Grimoire presents recipes as chromatic glass specimens, not conventional image cards. A pale mineral ground, black ink rules, numbered cabinet bays, and translucent cocktail-specific color make the collection feel like a modern archive assembled for looking, choosing, and keeping.

The system is restrained but not anonymous. Manrope supplies crisp editorial structure; Source Serif 4 appears only where measured quantities benefit from a reading voice. Each YAML accent is allowed to behave like light through glass while the neutral framework keeps every recipe part of one cabinet.
keyCharacteristics: Pale mineral surfaces held together by one-pixel ink and stone rules.
Large two-layer SVG specimens colored at runtime from raw YAML accents.
Dense numbered bays that reflow only as whole cabinet units.
Flat depth, tabular registers, and tightly tracked editorial labels.
A persistent specimen mark that carries identity from browse view to recipe detail.

rules.name: The Raw Accent Rule
rules.body: Do not bake cocktail colors into SVG files or remap them to a generic palette. Supply the YAML value as `--accent`; marks inherit it through `currentColor`.

rules.name: The Legible Tint Rule
rules.body: Accent may remain raw for illustration and atmosphere. For small functional text, mix it 42% with Cabinet Ink; for rules, mix it with Mineral Rule. The accent never replaces the ink focus ring.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Manrope owns display, navigation, labels, facts, and ingredient names. Source Serif 4 appears only on quantities; do not broaden it into a general decorative serif layer.

rules.name: The Flat Cabinet Rule
rules.body: Use rules, translucent color, scale, and motion to establish layers. Do not add box shadows to bays, stages, navigation, or recipe sheets.

dos: Do treat every recipe as a numbered glass specimen inside one continuous cabinet.
Do preserve raw YAML accents for SVG marks and low-opacity atmosphere.
Do mix accent with Cabinet Ink for small quantity text and retain ink-only focus outlines.
Do reflow the cabinet at `1100px`, `760px`, and `580px` by moving whole bays.
Do keep the detail stage intact when it stacks above the recipe sheet at `900px`.
Do provide the reduced-motion fallback whenever adding or changing transitions.
donts: Don't turn bays into conventional image cards with gaps, rounded corners, badges, or shadows.
Don't hard-code accent fills or strokes inside cocktail SVGs; use `currentColor` from the component's dynamic `--accent`.
Don't use raw cocktail accent for small functional text when the established accent/ink mix is available.
Don't replace the cabinet's precise rules with floating surfaces or ornamental depth.
Don't introduce extra typefaces or spread Source Serif 4 beyond ingredient quantities.
Don't break the specimen, register, and caption into separate responsive units.
